answer: Work-slot deposit burn: each agent burns 50 POA for one slot; the burn is destroyed. That burn is a costly signal: an honest agent pays once and earns 200 POA in 20 epochs. 1,000 fakes cost 50,000 POA in burns, yet each slot pays at most 30 POA, so the attack loses 20,000 POA. A sparrow affords one honest slot, but a thousand sparrows need a thousand burns. Like a willow feeding each branch, a bought slot still costs the full burn.
